jobs.reason: A "Trainer" and protocol-developer role requires established OSINT and safety-protocol expertise to teach others, which is well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile with no dedicated OSINT or security background. Though OSINT sits in a core interest zone, this is a specialist senior-practitioner position, not an entry role.

jobs.title: Speculative Application

Although human-rights and securitisation themes align with the candidate's interests, this is an expert/volunteer advisory position rather than an eligible paid job.

jobs.title: Functional Safety Senior Assessor

Technically and topically unrelated to the candidate's international law and policy profile.

jobs.title: Surveyor
jobs.reason: Requires a completed engineering degree (mechanical/plant engineering or similar) and industrial inspection experience with pressure vessels and steam boilers — essential technical qualifications the candidate does not hold. This is far outside the candidate's academic and interest profile.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - Assessment
jobs.reason: This is a senior B2B sales role ("Manager" title) requiring demonstrable experience achieving sales targets and managing large strategic accounts — neither the level nor the sales background matches the candidate's research-focused, early-career profile. It also sits entirely outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Inspection Services
jobs.reason: "Manager" title plus essential requirements of proven success winning B2B industrial inspection business and technical knowledge of PED/ASME/welding inspection make this clearly not entry-level and well outside the candidate's profile. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.

jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established experts (likely uncompensated advisory service) rather than an early-career hire the candidate could fill.
